title: Retired UK civil servant ordered to pay back £25,000 after pension scheme error

sentences: A retired civil servant faces being forced back into full-time work after being ordered to return £25,000 in overpaid pension benefits.
translations: 一名退休公务员因被要求退还2.5万英镑多领的养老金，面临被迫重返全职工作的困境。

sentences: Derek Ritchie, 63, was informed in March by scheme administrators that his payments had been miscalculated since 2014.
translations: 63岁的德里克·里奇在3月被告知，自2014年以来，他的付款被计划管理员计算错误。

sentences: In a letter, they apologised "for any inconvenience" and told him he would need to repay £25,000 by bank transfer or in instalments.
translations: 在一封信中，他们为“造成的不便”道歉，并告知他需要以银行转账或分期付款的方式偿还25,000英镑。

sentences: Ritchie (not his real name) asked for an explanation which he said he has not received.
Three months later he received the letter he was threatened with legal action if he did not start his refund payments.
translations: 里奇（非真名）要求一个解释，他表示自己尚未收到。
三个月后，他收到了那封信，信中威胁称如果他不开始支付退款，将采取法律行动。

sentences: "Over the last 11 years, I've made decisions, expenditures and plans based on the figures I was given and the mistake will cause me considerable hardship," said Ritchie, who was prescribed medication for depression and anxiety after having received the letter in March.
"I shall have to go back to work for years to pay this off."
translations: "在过去的11年里，我根据所给的数据做出了决策、支出和计划，这个错误将给我带来相当大的困难，"里奇说道，他在三月份收到这封信后被开了治疗抑郁和焦虑的药物。
"我将不得不回去工作多年才能还清这笔钱。"

sentences: Ritchie is one of hundreds of civil servants who have been ordered to return overpayments caused by administrative errors.
Some were told to repay six-figure sums.
translations: 里奇是数百名因行政错误而被要求退还多付款项的公务员之一。
有些人被告知需要偿还六位数的款项。

sentences: "Errors and overpayments have been a feature of outsourced pension administration," said Fran Heathcote, the general secretary of the Public and Commercial Services Union.
"Civil service pension administration should be done by civil servants under direct ministerial control.
When things go wrong, people suffer."
translations: "错误和超额支付一直是外包养老金管理的一个特点，"公共与商业服务工会总书记弗兰·希思科特说道。
"公务员养老金管理应由公务员在部长的直接控制下进行。
当出现问题时，人们就会受苦。"

sentences: MyCSP, which was appointed to manage civil service pensions on behalf of the Cabinet Office, admitted in 2019 that it was trying to claw back £2.7m of overpayments from more than 2,000 pensioners.
translations: MyCSP受命代表内阁办公室管理公务员养老金，于2019年承认其正试图从2000多名养老金领取者那里追回270万英镑的多付款项。

sentences: The errors had come to light during a big review ordered by the Cabinet Office.
However, the review failed to spot the overpayments to Ritchie.
Instead, they rose from about £200 a year to £4,000.
translations: 这些错误是在内阁办公室下令进行的一次大规模审查中曝光的。
然而，这次审查未能发现对里奇的多付款项。
相反，这些多付款项从每年约200英镑增加到了4000英镑。

sentences: His income has been reduced by 13% a month and MyCSP told him it would deduct a further 15% a month to recover the debt if he did not agree to a payment plan.
translations: 他的月收入减少了13%，MyCSP告诉他，如果他不同意还款计划，每月将再扣除15%以收回债务。

sentences: Pension providers have a legal duty to recover overpayments even when scheme members accept them in good faith.
However, the debt may be reduced if pensioners can provide evidence that they have spent the money and would suffer significant hardship by making repayments.
translations: 养老金提供者有法律责任追回多付的款项，即使计划成员是善意接受的。
然而，如果养老金领取者能提供证据证明他们已花掉这笔钱，并且还款将导致其遭受重大困难，则债务可能会被减免。

sentences: Ritchie said his pension valuation encouraged him to take early retirement when his position at the Ministry of Defence came up for redundancy in 2014.
He has since worked part-time as a mental healthcare assistant and had planned to retire fully in 2027.
translations: 里奇表示，2014年他在国防部的职位面临裁员时，养老金估值促使他选择了提前退休。
此后，他一直兼职担任心理健康护理助理，并计划在2027年完全退休。

sentences: "I might have chosen to continue my career within the ministry or opt for the redundancy deal available under the voluntary early release scheme if I'd known my income would be lower," he said.
translations: 他说：“如果我早知道我的收入会降低，我可能会选择继续在部里工作，或者选择自愿提前离职计划下的裁员补偿方案。”

sentences: The Cabinet Office said it sympathised with Ritchie but had a duty to recover public money paid out in error.
"We apply stringent guidelines on the recovery of overpayments, and work to ensure any money is recovered with flexibility and the least burden possible," said a spokesperson.
translations: 内阁办公室表示，他们对里奇表示同情，但有责任追回错误支付的公共资金。
一位发言人表示：“我们对追回多付款项执行严格的指导方针，并努力确保以灵活的方式、尽可能减少负担地追回任何资金。”

sentences: In October, a parliamentary select committee report accused the Cabinet Office of mismanaging the outsourced pension scheme and blamed MyCSP for "unacceptable" service levels.

The report from the public accounts committee also highlighted concerns about the transfer of the £239m management contract from MyCSP to Capita and suggested the service should instead be managed in house.
translations: 10月，一份议会特别委员会报告指责内阁办公室对外包养老金计划管理不善，并批评MyCSP的服务水平“不可接受”。
公共账目委员会的这份报告还强调了将2.39亿英镑的管理合同从MyCSP转移至Capita的担忧，并建议该服务应由内部管理。

sentences: Capita took over the scheme this week.
The Guardian has reported on delays with the Teachers' Pensions scheme that it runs.
translations: Capita 本周接管了该计划。
《卫报》报道了其运营的教师养老金计划出现延误的情况。

sentences: The company said: "We bring over 50 years of pensions expertise, modern technology including AI, a focus on innovation, and a commitment to social value, and are working in partnership with the Cabinet Office to build a more intuitive service that meets the needs of members."
translations: 该公司表示：“我们拥有超过50年的养老金专业经验、包括人工智能在内的现代技术、对创新的关注以及对社会价值的承诺，并与内阁办公室合作，打造更直观、满足会员需求的服务。”

sentences: Ritchie said he was awaiting an explanation of how the mistake arose and had no way of knowing whether the revised figures were correct.
translations: 里奇表示，他正在等待关于错误如何发生的解释，并且无法知道修订后的数据是否准确。

sentences: "Government rules say a member should be placed in the position they would have been in had an overpayment error not occurred," he said.
"Unless they are able to give me back the last 11 years and enable me to review and change my financial decisions, they've left me in a nightmare with no way out."
translations: "政府规定指出，成员应被置于未发生多付错误时本应处于的位置，" 他说。
"除非他们能让我回到过去11年，并让我重新审视和改变我的财务决策，否则他们就把我留在了无法摆脱的噩梦中。"
